patterns.note: Extensive use of horizontal thin lines to segment content, create visual hierarchy, and separate list items, giving a structured, editorial feel.
A strong typographic contrast between oversized, very thin serif display fonts for primary headings and project titles, and a smaller, clean sans-serif or monospace font for body text and labels.
A high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates the entire site, with minimal and very subtle color accents used sparingly for specific interactive elements or details.
Large display text elements (like project names and introductory phrases) animate into view with a subtle vertical slide-up or fade-in effect as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic reveal sequence.
The initial hero section features a large, central logo that disappears on scroll, replaced by a smaller, sticky navigation bar that appears on interior pages, indicating a transforming header.
Content sections are often introduced by a large, single word or short phrase, followed by a horizontal line, before revealing the main content block.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a custom smooth scrolling library (like locomotive-scroll) to enhance the user experience, enabling precise control over scroll-triggered animations and a fluid page feel.

Scroll-triggered reveals are implemented using CSS keyframes or JavaScript (potentially with a library like GSAP or ScrollTrigger, often integrated with locomotive-scroll) to animate large text elements and content sections into view with subtle fade-ins and vertical translations as they enter the viewport.

A dynamic header system is employed where the initial hero logo on the homepage gives way to a compact, sticky navigation bar on interior pages, providing persistent access to key sections while adapting to different content layouts.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, thin serif headings (~4-5x body text) with small, often uppercase, clean sans-serif labels and body text, creating a dramatic and elegant contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout; no visible rounded elements, reinforcing a precise and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero and initial content areas, creating a sense of luxury and minimalism, with content grids maintaining balanced but generous padding.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, editorial typography, particularly the use of extremely large, thin serif fonts for primary content and project titles, combined with a minimalist, high-contrast black-and-white aesthetic. The dynamic, scroll-triggered text animations in the hero section, revealing these large titles, create a unique and engaging introduction that feels more like an art installation than a typical website.
